derivation.overrides_excluded: Runtime custom/Info.plist manifest overrides were not included; 51 default configured public endpoints only.

methods.referenced_assets: Anonymous HTTPS HEAD, redirects allowed only HTTPS, compare final Content-Length when present
methods.integrity: Manifest SHA-256 computed; asset SHA-256 syntax and positive bytes validated, artifact bodies not downloaded or hashed

limitations: No database bodies downloaded; bytes/hashes of full assets are not content-verified.
HEAD success does not prove SQLite schema/coverage freshness/runtime matcher correctness or a successful end-to-end device download.
Delta index is only HEAD-checked; chained patches referenced inside it are not fetched.
HTTP responses are point-in-time, not future availability guarantees.
This audit does not publish, modify or rebuild map data, rules or speed-reference policy.
No authentication, GitHub API token, netrc or curl configuration is used.
